title: Update on the Collateral Ratio Under Portfolio Margin and the Leverage & Margin Tiers of USDⓈ-M Perpetual Contracts
text: This is a general announcement. Products and services referred to here may not be available in your region. The update will be completed within approximately  30 minutes .
